IFX Sells NOR Flash To Winbond
: Infineon agreed to sell NOR Flash and F‑RAM business to Winbond for $1.12B cash‑and‑debt‑free. Deal excludes other memory units, needs regulatory approval, targeted close H2 2027; IFX shares ~€55.
AI Data Centers Drive IFX Revenue
: Infineon CEO Jochen Hanebeck says AI data centers could generate about 20% of IFX revenue, highlighting demand for the company’s power infrastructure components used in AI compute workloads.
: Infineon (IFX): CEO says automotive is the largest sales segment; fastest growth expected in power infrastructure (generation, transmission, storage) as India speeds electrification.

: Infineon (IFX) opened two India Centres of Excellence with NILIT and NIELIT to train semiconductor engineers and boost industry-ready technical talent, enhancing Infineon’s local workforce pipeline.

: Infineon (IFX) is developing humanoid-robotics subsystems, including advanced sensing and tactile sensors for dexterous robotic hands; projects are ongoing development, not product launches or sales.
